description:
WHAT: Extension trait on jmap-base-client::Session providing chat-specific capability accessors.

ALGORITHM:
1. Create crate-jmap-chat-client/src/session.rs
2. Define structs:
   - pub struct ChatCapability { pub max_size_message_body: u64, pub supported_body_types: Vec<String>, ... } — parse from account_capabilities["urn:ietf:params:jmap:chat"]
   - pub struct ChatPushCapability { pub max_snippet_bytes: Option<u64>, ... } — from account_capabilities["urn:ietf:params:jmap:chat:push"]
3. Define pub trait ChatSessionExt:
   fn chat_account_id(&self) -> Option<&str>   → self.primary_account_id("urn:ietf:params:jmap:chat")
   fn chat_capability(&self, account_id: &str) -> Result<Option<ChatCapability>, ClientError>   → deserialize from account_capabilities
   fn chat_push_capability(&self, account_id: &str) -> Result<Option<ChatPushCapability>, ClientError>
   fn supports_chat_websocket(&self) -> bool   → capabilities.contains_key("urn:ietf:params:jmap:chat:websocket")
   fn vapid_public_key(&self) -> Option<&str>   → capabilities["urn:ietf:params:jmap:webpush-vapid"]["vapidPublicKey"].as_str()
   fn supports_refplus(&self) -> bool   → capabilities.contains_key("urn:ietf:params:jmap:refplus")
   fn supports_quotas(&self) -> bool   → capabilities.contains_key("urn:ietf:params:jmap:quotas")
4. impl ChatSessionExt for jmap_base_client::Session { ... }
5. Declare in lib.rs: pub mod session; pub use session::ChatSessionExt;

Source: ~/PROJECT/crate-jmapchat-client/src/jmap.rs Session impl — port the methods.

DEFENSIVE RULES:
- All capability lookups return Ok(None) on missing key, Err(ClientError::Parse) on malformed JSON
- No unwrap()

TESTS:
- chat_account_id_present: session with primaryAccounts chat entry → returns Some
- chat_account_id_absent: empty primaryAccounts → returns None
- chat_capability_parses: valid ChatCapability JSON → Ok(Some(cap))
- supports_chat_websocket: capabilities has the key → true; absent → false

ACCEPTANCE: 4 named tests pass; clippy clean
